$comment: Authoritative test manifest for AgentDev Lab. Any agent or CI job MUST run these commands verbatim. Commands are never to be weakened, narrowed, or replaced to make a run look better. Counts are deliberately absent: run `python3 -m benchmark stats`.

suites.description: Full unit and integration suite for the harness, including adversarial adapters and execution of every curated SQL analysis.

Harness self-validation: runs the noop and oracle controls over every registered task, asserts the expected pass/fail polarity, and evaluates each pristine fixture twice to prove the task is deterministic.
Verifies that no task fixture, protected test file, or stored result has been tampered with.
Adversarial isolation suite. A hostile canary adapter attacks its own boundary from the inside; every probe must be denied. Skipped, loudly, if no backend can enforce a boundary on this machine.

gate.description: A milestone may only be committed when every authoritative suite exits 0. A comparison may only be published when `benchmark experiment verify` also passes; see docs/comparison-protocol.md.

setup.description: Verifies the environment and runs every authoritative suite. No installation required.
